newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan says Q2 hurt by trading losses.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan says Q2 hurt by trading losses.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said Thursday proprietary investing and trading revenues declined during the second quarter to $116 million, from $216 million.
The company said trading losses in the second quarter were $17 million, as opposed to gains of $128 million in the year-earlier period.
The bank said revenues from emerging markets fell to $123 million, from $151 million in the year-earlier period, as a result of lower revenues from external debt trading.

Revenues from its finance advisory businesses rose 13 percent to $481 million, in line with increased investment banking activity, while market making revenues climbed slightly to $643 million, from $639 million, it said.
J.P. Morgan also said it took a a charge of $28 million in the quarter in conection with the renovation of its New York City office space.
